ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Binaries import * from dw::core::Arrays
output application/PDF with binary
var index = payload.AZsign.WebHook.AcuerdoInfo.Documentos.Atributos indexWhere (item) -> item.Naturaleza == "S" var doc = payload.AZsign.WebHook.AcuerdoInfo.Documentos.Documento[index] --- fromBase64(doc as String) as Binary

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json var fecha = now() >> "America/Bogota"
--- { ResponseAcuerdo: write(vars.initialPayload,"application/xml"), FechaEnvio: fecha, Asesor: vars.dataStorage.usuario, FechaRespuesta: fecha, Aplicacion: "MULESOFT", NumeroDocumento: payload.AZsign.WebHook.AcuerdoInfo.GruposPartcipantes[0].DocumentoIdentificacion }

%dw 2.0 output multipart/form-data import * from dw::module::Multipart --- parts: { container: field({name: "container", value: ((vars.dataStorage.container splitBy ("/"))[0] as String)}), filename: field({name: "filename", value: (vars.dataStorage.container splitBy ("/"))[1] ++ "/" ++ vars.dataStorage.fileName}), file: field({name: "file", value: vars.documentoFirmado, mime: "application/pdf"}) }
